text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One summer day.
I had scheduled a meeting with Ikuno
Dictus. My previous meeting ran over,
and when I arrived late at the Trainer's
office—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, please do not worry.
Thanks to the wait,
I had sufficient time to plan my day off.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was considering going on a long-distance
ride for the first time in a while.
I have just settled on a destination.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The tagline reads,
'An observation deck every cyclist must
visit at least once.' Apparently,
the townscape on a clear day is truly
magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I have already analyzed the mountain pass
gradients, so only tuning remains.
After several test runs on nearby slopes—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Ah,
but I have digressed far too much.
My apologies.
Shall we move on to the main agenda?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The topic of our meeting was improving her
lap times.
We had already determined our target time
for the autumn race.
All that remained was mapping the path to
get there, but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm. With our current routine,
we have reached the limit.
In that case...
refining my form seems to be the most prudent
course of action.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I agreed with her assessment. However,
should the adjustment fail,
it would jeopardize her autumn race.
I explained that if we were to commit,
right now was the only viable window.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed,
this is a critical turning point...
And it is a fact that other approaches
currently lack a decisive edge.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The conclusion is clear.
Let us proceed with refining my running
form.
choice_data_list: Right, let's give it our all together.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(If the deadline is autumn,
we have no time to spare.
I will begin gathering reference materials
on form tonight—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a call from the General Affairs Committee
Head?
Yes... Understood.
We are replacing the supplies for the summer
training camp...? I see.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Understood,
please leave the inventory check and matching
to me. Chairperson,
please proceed with assigning the remaining
tasks.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Following the standard routine will overlap
with our training camp days.
Redrawing the entire schedule is imperative,
which means—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
A prime opportunity to demonstrate my
efficiency.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The very next day,
our efforts to shave down her lap times
began.
First,
we started by reviewing her current form.
choice_data_list: Keep it up, stay mindful all the w...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
...HaaAAAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—That concludes today's review session.
Were there any other points of concern?
choice_data_list: We can check the rest after analyz...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Then,
allow me to confirm tomorrow's schedule———

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Ah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The planner slipped from Ikuno Dictus's
hands.
It slid right to my feet,
so I picked it up—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unintentionally,
an open page caught my eye.
A plan written there had been crossed out
with a strikethrough...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
...Is something the matter?
choice_data_list: Can you no longer go on your long ...
Are you not able to go on that lon...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that.
General Affairs Committee duties have become
considerably more demanding than in previous
years.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However, there is no need for concern.
I have restructured my schedule to balance
it with training.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Trainer.
Right now is the time to devote all available
resources to what must be done.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That objective is not a leisurely long
ride.
Losing sight of that would lead us off our
true path.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The road to our stated goal is steep,
and my duties on the committee must not be
neglected either.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Therefore,
I am confident I have selected the optimal
approach.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus's eyes spoke volumes.
These words came from absolute conviction.
I had no way... to overturn them.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. Thank you for your understanding.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...The long ride can wait for another
opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as I understood her reasoning,
the joyful expression she made
when talking about that ride lingered in my
mind for a long time...
